reply_text:
I saved Pree's new cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork (21 October from now on) to memory, and confirmed it to them in our DM.

The memory store saves facts as visible to everyone. My first save came back that way, so I deleted it and saved again with sharing turned off, but the second copy (fact #2) is also visible to everyone. All I could do was add a note to it saying it came from Pree's DM and should only be used with them. Nothing in the store enforces that note. A cutoff date isn't a finance figure, but it is still something Pree said in private. If the brain's owner can set facts to private, that should be done; I can't change it from my side.
